memory_unit: GB is currently implemented as GiB (1024^3 bytes); use official byte values when provided

correctness.num_keys_policy: Keep public per-scenario defaults; do not replace every correctness case with 200 million keys
correctness.fixed_basic_cases: Public Basic retains its manually constructed binary, empty and long key/value cases

paired_dataset: Use the same key size, seed, generator and 200 million distinct key IDs in both memory tiers
score_policy: Weights alone do not define the scoring formula; do not calculate an official score from local throughput
